The best free time zone converters and world clocks

Converting a time across cities is easy; finding a meeting slot that suits everyone, or knowing the exact time, is where the tools differ. Here is what each one does for free, from its own pages.

We make Slop Time, one of the tools on this page. Every fact about the other tools comes from their own pages, linked under each one, as they read on 2026-10-24. Prices and features change: check each site before you choose.

How we compared them

  • Convert a time and compare several cities at once
  • Plan a meeting across time zones and share it
  • Exact time, apps and widgets
  • Sign-up, and where the time comes from

1. World Time Buddy

Best for: Comparing several cities hour by hour and sending a meeting to your calendar

Good

  • World clock, time zone converter and meeting scheduler in one grid
  • Add a chosen time to Outlook, iCal or Google Calendar, or share a link
  • World clock and event widgets, and a mobile app; time zone data from TZDATA

Not so good

  • Settings are saved only if you sign in
  • The page needs JavaScript to work

World Time Buddy website · Sources: World Time Buddy, About World Time Buddy

2. Slop Time (ours)

Best for: Planning across time zones privately and offline, with working hours shown

A world clock with the local time, GMT offset and working hours in each city, a converter, a meeting planner that finds the hours everyone is at work, a stopwatch and a timer, all from your browser's own time zone data.

Good

  • Every IANA time zone, with daylight saving from your browser's own data
  • Meeting planner by working hours; a chosen slot can be saved to Slop Calendar
  • Stopwatch and countdown timer; the times come from your browser, not a time server, and it works offline

Not so good

  • The time is your device clock; to correct it you type a reference time by hand
  • No share links, no calendar invites for other apps, no phone app or widgets
  • Still being built

Open Slop Time

4. Time.is

Best for: Checking the exact time anywhere, and how far off your own clock is

Good

  • Exact, official atomic clock time for more than 7 million locations in 58 languages
  • Time zone converter for several places, countdown, timer and widgets

Not so good

  • The ad-free subscription is not open to new subscribers, as its page says
  • Its apps page lists only an iPad app so far

Time.is website · Sources: Time.is, Time.is converter, Time.is apps, Time.is FAQ, Time.is Ad-free

Which one to choose

World Time Buddy is the best all-rounder for comparing cities and sending a meeting to a calendar, with apps and widgets. Time.is is the one to trust for the exact time. Every Time Zone is the quickest visual timeline, with meetings in Pro.

Slop Time fits when you want working hours and a meeting planner without sign-up, worked out on your device and usable offline. It relies on your device clock and cannot send invites to other calendars.

Questions

What is the best free time zone converter?

World Time Buddy for comparing many cities and planning calls, Every Time Zone for a quick timeline, Time.is for the exact time, and Slop Time for a private planner that works offline.

Which tool shows the exact time?

Time.is says it shows exact atomic clock time from its server. Slop Time uses your device clock, with a manual offset if you know it is off.

Do these handle daylight saving time?

Slop Time uses your browser's time zone data for the date you pick, so the offset in force that day is used. World Time Buddy names TZDATA as its main data source.

Can I plan a meeting across time zones for free?

Yes. World Time Buddy, Every Time Zone and Slop Time all help find a time; Slop Time shows the hours when everyone is inside working hours.
